name: Kanojo wa Dare to demo Sex Suru.
original_name: 彼女は誰とでもセックスする。
source:
See that quiet, plain looking girl who sits away from the rest of class?
Sullen and glum, she gets talked about behind her back, but she's an earnest and tender girl.
---Yes, only I know the goodness that's in her.
---And yet, everything about her is a deception!

"Sorry...... Basically, I just like...... to have sex?"

Protagonist Kazuhiro Sayama tastes shock and despair watching his first love bang the despicable gym teacher.
He dreamed of being her white knight boyfriend,
and for that he's rewarded with the duty of documenting her f*ck like an animal with pretty much any guy.

The curtains rise on an X-rated, pants-rousing yariman kanojo observation AVG from
the talented team of artist Torajiro Sanagi & author Otohito Anno!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE137561.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
看看那个安静、朴素、独自坐在班级角落的女孩？
她阴沉郁闷，背后常被人议论，但其实认真而温柔。
——没错，只有我知道她的优点。
——然而，她的一切都是骗局！

“对不起……其实，我只是喜欢……做爱？”

主角佐山和弘亲眼看见初恋与卑劣的体育老师性交，品尝到震惊与绝望。
他梦想成为她的白马骑士男友，
得到的却是记录她像野兽一样与几乎任何男人性交的任务。

由才华横溢的画师沙流寅次郎与作者安野音人联手打造的成人、令人兴奋的“淫乱女友观察”AVG，拉开帷幕！
